instruction: Increase the mouse cursor size to make it easier to see and follow on the screen.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: CURSOR_SIZE=$(timeout 10 gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CURSOR_SIZE" ] && [ "$CURSOR_SIZE" -gt 24 ]; then echo "Large cursor enabled (size: $CURSOR_SIZE)"; else echo "Cursor not enlarged (size: ${CURSOR_SIZE:-default})"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires increasing cursor size for better visibility. The evaluator checks if org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-size is greater than 24 (default is typically 24, so anything larger indicates enlarged cursor). This is verified via gsettings command.
metadata.verification: Verified that gsettings command checks cursor-size numeric value in org.gnome.desktop.interface schema, with threshold > 24 for enlarged cursor
